condition.description:
Filtered MetricsQL predicate. Every returned series is a match, including a zero-valued
sample. Use filtering comparisons, not the bool modifier. Empty results are unknown,
not recovery. Configure recovery_condition to resolve on positive healthy evidence.
Aggregate away volatile labels such as container_id for stable resource identity.

freshness_query.description: MetricsQL query returning source observation Unix timestamps with the same resource labels. Required for enabled rules; derived queries must return the oldest required source timestamp.

recovery_condition.description: Filtered healthy predicate with the same resource labels as condition. Required for enabled rules; missing telemetry never resolves an incident.

recovery_duration.description: Duration of fresh healthy evidence required to resolve; Go duration syntax, zero allowed.

max_sample_age.description: Maximum observation age and implicit MetricsQL lookback; positive Go duration.
